_comment: Site-wide switches that more than one build step needs to agree on. Kept as JSON so both the Astro layouts and the plain-Node build scripts read the same bytes — the noindex meta tag and robots.txt drifting apart is the exact failure this file exists to prevent.
indexableNote: Turned on 20 August 2026, after the answer pages were renamed for the questions they answer. Turning this off again does not un-index anything that has already been crawled; it only stops future crawls.
